content: Roh ma namlolo noro roh hayakyaka

Wal'u na'ahoru man ya aramyaka. Meser nammori aile man wakuku ha ma ka namlolo, la mahar lalaa mamai lolo noho wawan me'e. Ende yon mi akim naili'il ri na'akeme ma na'aheni Makromod Lalap Nin Roh aile hi raram, maa koklolo ma'inau rir wanakuku leke mauroin Makromod Lalap Nin Roh nodi molollo hi, ee ka.
Modi kalla eniyeni leke mauroin roh ma namlolo noro roh ma ka namlolo: Lo'o ri ida na'aheni Yesus Kristus mai noho wawan namwali ri mormori, ai onne nin Roh mai nano Makromod Lalap.

Maa, lo'o ri namehin na'aheni Yesus kan mai noho wawan la ka namwali ri mormori naise maika, ai onne nin roh kan mai nano Makromod Lalap, maa mai nano Kristus Nin arwali. Mim dernedi me'e nahenia ler ida arwali onne lo'o mai noho wawan, maa lere eni maiyedi me'e.

Enimaa ya an'u na'ahoru, mi eniyenihe Makromod Lalap Nine ri. Mi ka makani meser ma ka namlolo onnenihe, de mim rehiyedi hi, ono Makromod Lalap man aile mi akim nodi molollo narehi nano hayakyak man aile noho eniyeni.
Meser ma ka namlolo onnenihe noho wawan nin ri, de hir wakunu ha ma na'ono noho wawan nin wanakuku mamani, la noho wawan nin ri raram nodi derne rakani rira wanakunu.

Enimaa ik eniyenihe Makromod Lalap Nin ri, de inhoi ma nauroin Makromod Lalap, ai onne derne nakani iknik wanakunu, maa ri ma ka namwali Makromod Lalap anan, kar derne rakani maika. Nano onne ik kauroin idewe inhoi nina Roh ma namlolo, noro idewe inhoi nina roh ma nodi ri laa yakanne.
Makromod Lalap naramyak ananhe leke hi ida ma naramyaka ida
I wal'u na'ahoru man ya aramyaka, na'amoli ika ida ma naramyaka ida, ono raramyaka onne mai nano Makromod Lalap. Inhoi naramyaka ri, ai onne Makromod Lalap ananne, la nauroiroin Makromod Lalap.
Maa inhoi ka naramyaka ri, ai onne ka nauroin Makromod Lalap, ono Makromod Lalap penia raramyaka onno.
Ik kauroin Makromod Lalap naramyaka ika ono Ai nala Anan Kuru Mehe Lai Mehe mai noho wawan leke ik lernala or'ori dardari nano Ai.
Ende Nin raramyaka onne penia ma namlolo, iknik ka. Makromod Lalap penia ma naramyaka ika, la nala Anan namwali honoi kanani leke na'ohu nahala iknik dohohala.
I wal'u na'ahoru man ya aramyaka, Makromod Lalap naramyaka ika rehi, de wa'an rehi ik ida ma naramyaka ida haenhi.
Ri mahaku kan do'onnala Makromod Lalap makun, maa lo'o ik ida ma naramyak ida, Makromod Lalap moriwuku noro ika, la Nin raramyaka penpenu kemkeme aile ik raram penia ik karamyaka ri kokkoo.
Makromod Lalap naledi Nin Roh maika me'e, de ik kauroin nahenia ik moriwukuwedi noro Ai me'e, la Ai namwali mahaku noro ika.
Ai mehem do'onedi la kukumaka nahenia Makromod Lalap nala Anan mai leke namwali Rai Ma Nala Or'ori Dardari lolo noho wawan.
Inhoi ma ne'e nahenia Makromod Yesus onne Makromod Lalap Anan, Makromod Lalap namkene moriwuku noro ai, la roro ramwali mahaku.

Enpenia ik akin namkene ono kauroinedi nahenia Makromod Lalap naramyaka ika. Makromod Lalap onne penia raramyaka onno, de inhoi nin morimori naramyaka ri mamani, ai onne noro Makromod Lalap namwali mahaku, la Makromod Lalap moriwuku noro ai.
Nano panaeku eni ik kauroin nahenia Makromod Lalap Nin raramyaka penpenu kemkeme aile maika leke yon ik kamka'uk rakan Lere Alam Hono'ok Kanail, ono lolo noho wawan ik mori naise Yesus haenhi.

Ri ma nauroin kokkoo Makromod Lalap naramyaka ai, ka namka'uk. Maa ri ma ka nauroin Makromod Lalap Nin raramyaka, ai namka'uk lernala dohohala nin hunukum. Raramyaka man penpenu kemkeme onne penia ma na'amoluloinedi kamka'uk onneni, de ri man lernaledi Makromod Lalap Nin raramyaka onne, ka ramka'uk me'e. Maa ri ma ka nauroin Makromod Lalap Nin raramyaka man penpenu kemkeme eni, ramka'uk makun.
Makromod Lalap naramyaka ika nolu, penia ik karamyak Ai noro iknik ri heri ri wali.

Lo'o ri ida na'aheni, “Ya aramyaka Makromod Lalap,” maa ai kan suk walinhe, ai onne napoho. Lo'o ri ida ka naramyaka walinhe man an dodo'on, hi'ihehewi ai naramyaka Makromod Lalap man ai kan dodo'on? Onne ka namwali wake'e.
Enla, Makromod Lalap komdere ika na'ahenia, “Mi ri ma naramyaka Maya'u, maramyaka mi walinhe haenhi.”
